text:
Maria: Heads-up — the Ruby quickstart in the repo has a copy/paste bug in the curl example. It uses "Auth: Bearer" instead of "Authorization: Bearer" so folks get 401s while onboarding. Also noticed the Ruby snippet missing the require line.

Maria: Example mismatch in README: 
```bash
# wrong (current README)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "Auth: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

Maria: The Ruby client snippet also starts with `client = Redwood::Client.new(...)` but no `require` line so copy/paste from the page fails for beginners.

Devon: Ack, thanks for spotting. Can you point to the file path?

Maria: It's docs/quickstarts/ruby/README.md around the curl and the code sample block (line ~42). I'll open a PR with the Authorization header and add `require 'redwood'` at top.

Sam: Oh yeah we changed the gem name earlier in the beta flip. IIRC the gem is `redwood_inference` now, not `redwood`. We should confirm the exact require so we don't flip again.

Priya: @Maria thanks — I'll review once you submit. Also +1 on adding a tiny smoke check to CI that runs the curl snippet against the staging mock and fails if it returns 401 or if header name isn't Authorization. That would catch copy/paste header regressions.

Devon: We can add a docs-snippet-lint job that parses code fences and validates known header names / env var usages. Lightweight.

Maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/1234 — changes: replace Auth -> Authorization, add `require 'redwood_inference'` and clarify env var name (REDWOOD_API_KEY). Included a note in the ruby quickstart about verifying gem name.

docs-bot: Created issue #3421 for ruby quickstart header + require mismatch (reporter: Maria).

Sam: Nice. Quick note: also adjust the code sample to use the SDK idiom we recommend now (the `chat.create` call is fine but show `client.chat.create(...).message` -> maybe we should stick to the minimal example). Keep it short so it doesn't intimidate new devs.

Priya: Also add a 1-liner in the contributing docs about copy/paste hazards — remind authors to run the curl locally and to test language snippets. Small docs QA step.

Maria: Will update PR with those doc hints and add a tiny GitHub action to run the curl against docs-staging.

Devon: Thanks — once CI is green let's merge. :thumbsup:

Maria: Merged and backported to the 1.0 branch. Leaving this thread in case someone wants the lint job details.

Sam: Filed a separate ticket to standardize Ruby SDK require names across all examples.

Priya: Great catch, Maria. Saves new users a lot of head-scratching. :heart:
